# Gaston Borch, Oriental Pictures

Gaston Borch, *Oriental Pictures*, I. *Sunrise and Incantations*, II. *The Caravan* and III. *Rest*. Piano parts typeset by Cypressdome (2021). The PDFs and compressed MusicXML files are unmodified copies from the same edition. [IMSLP edition, piano PDFs #679646–679648 and source archive #679650](https://imslp.org/wiki/Oriental_Pictures_(Borch,_Gaston)) · [Creative Commons Attribution-ShareAlike 4.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

Sunrise and Incantations prints Lento and Andantino. Its MusicXML supplies numeric playback tempos and six invisible grace notes at the repeat in measure 50. The PDF shows both mordents below the notes and explicit secondary beam breaks in measures 1, 3, 31, 32 and 34.

The printed Caravan score says Moderato. The MusicXML additionally supplies a playback tempo and two invisible F5 grace notes at the ends of measures 20 and 29.

The Rest PDF prints Andante and Allegretto quasi Andantino. Its MusicXML adds tempo numbers and four hidden grace notes near the jump to the coda.
